race.comment: BELLARATA (3) drove through late to score at Lismore, getting the job done despite racing keenly and being held up around the home turn. Has built a handy little record for herself and keeps the winning rider with a claim. Can raise the bar again. NIGHT MARKET (9) was dominant when shedding his maiden tag at Warwick after heavy support, though the move from 800m to 1100m is a query, where she has been unplaced twice. FINAL VOYAGE (8) has been honest all prep and can give another bold sight on the quick back-up with Thompson steering. Can steal it if left alone through the middle stages. SUMMER STUNNER (11) chased soundly into fourth behind BELLARATA last time and now meets the winner with a 4kg swing after McColm's claim. Have to include.
